description: Unit test class for JsonFactory in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package, testing JSON parsing, object creation, and field definitions.

classes.name: JsonFactoryTest
classes.description: A series of unit tests verifying the behavior of the JsonFactory utility class, including value creation, parsing, and field definitions.
